captions.detailed: A tilt-and-slide moonroof cassette consisting of a rectangular outer frame with rounded corners made of silver-grey aluminum, and a dark-tinted glass panel in the center. The glass panel is designed to tilt upward at its rear edge relative to the front edge, and then slide rearward along parallel guide rails integrated into the side profiles of the main frame.
captions.instruction: Generate a tilt-and-slide moonroof cassette with a rectangular aluminum outer frame and a central glass panel. The assembly must include a prismatic joint for the sliding action and a revolute joint at the front edge to support tilting.
captions.factory: The code defines a parametric assembly using custom classes for parts and joints. The main frame is constructed by subtracting a smaller rounded rectangle from a larger one to form the hollow aluminum frame. The glass panel is modeled as a flat plate with rounded outer edges. A prismatic articulation is defined to model the sliding motion along the longitudinal axis, and a revolute articulation is defined to model the tilt function.
